Dashboard & Displays

Depending on your role, make sure you have the correct options selected!

Note: If you have other roles, you can create and customize dashboards for each one.

Click “Reset Dashboards” or “Select Widgets” to enable Teacher Quick Access.

Click “Click here to select classes to display for quick access.”

Select your preferences. Then click Save.

This will create dashboard shortcuts to the gradebook and attendance entry for each class.

Mouse over the refresh symbol in any widget to see options. Click and drag any widget to move.

To only see your current term classes in dropdown menus.

Click Teacher Access > My Gradebook AND My Classes (two different selections).

Select “Current” in both “My Gradebook” and “My Classes.”

Now you will only see current term classes in menus. This will update itself every trimester.

To make it easier to find the correct class. Give your classes an additional nickname that only you can see. This is especially helpful for concurrent sections.

Click Teacher Access > My Classes.

Click “Nickname Classes.” Create and Save your nicknames, which will show up in most places on Skyward. It can be helpful to choose names that are an abbreviation of the class period, the class period with the school the students are coming from, your advisory, etc.

Reports and Charts

There are MANY different kinds of reports. Select one, choose or create a template, and modify settings until you get what you’re looking for!

Student Information

Navigate to a student’s profile to see indicators. You can also see these in your class list, attendance, and if you have indicators enabled in your gradebook view.

  • In BARR cohort
  • EL Student/Multilingual Learner: check schedule and contact EL teacher for more information.
  • Emergency health condition. Click for info and see health concerns list (from health office).
  • IEP: see below.

Great for advisory check-ins.
